I can look into that. Do you have the account reference?
Yes, it ends in four-eight-one.

Okay, thanks. Looking at your account, it looks like a reading validation issue. For the readings to be validated, every meter at your property must be registered on the account. It seems one of your meters was omitted, which flagged the account. Let me fix that for you.
Understood; I compared the meters with the account.
I've corrected the error and put in a request for a new statement. Are your statements usually paper or electronic?
Electronic, it arrives by email.
Got it. And I see your contact phone number ends in five-five-two, is that still correct?
Yes, that is correct.
Yep, both meters on the premises are included in your account now. Anything else I can help with today?
The property has two meters, and the supplier profile lists both of them.
Sure. I'll take a look. Does your household use electric or gas heating?
It is all electric here.
Got it. Since you're using all-electric, I'll update that information on your profile. Has your household size changed this quarter?
No, still the same two of us.
Got it. Any new appliances lately? Large ones?
No, nothing new like that.
No problem. You have two meters on the profile now, so we can make everything right. Do you pay by a fixed monthly amount, or a variable one?
Yes, a fixed amount each month.

Got it. I've updated your profile to properly account for the two meters. Your next electronic statement should accurately reflect that. Has anyone from the fuel company been out to your property recently?
No, nobody has visited.
Great. Those updates are done. Would you like the outcome by email as well?
Yes, email is fine.
Sure thing. I'll include the meter updates and billing reconciliation for your two-meter property in the email. Should I also include a breakdown by period?
Yes, that would be helpful.

Okay, I will wait to hear back.
